 UPDATE: 11:53 PM | November 3, 2026. The results below reflect the latest numbers from the Board of Elections. We have marked them all as unofficial, as all races either have all precincts reporting results or a few stragglers that will not make a difference. We will update the counts on the morning of November 4, 2026. Keep in mind that provisional votes and ballots that arrived (or will arrive) by mail, or were deposited in drop boxes since the last collection. 
 Anne Arundel County voters are deciding a wide range of races, including contests for county executive, County Council, sheriff, the Maryland General Assembly, Circuit Court, Congress, and many others. The results below will be updated as we receive Election Day returns and ballot counts.
 These totals are unofficial and will continue to change. Mail-in ballots postmarked by Election Day may arrive and be counted later, along with provisional ballots and additional mail-in canvasses, so final results may not be available for several weeks.
